name: Makita Hiroyuki
source:
Hiroyuki is a freelance web designer, living alone in his apartment. His workplace and home are very SOHO-styled.

He's a kind person who likes taking care of others. He's particularly kind to children. He's a perverted sort who's very open-minded and open to almost anything, be it softer or somewhat hardcore. He's also an otaku, who loves anime and video games.
